Third-party files in nas/web (all usable offline, no CDN):

fonts/AdwaitaSans.woff2, fonts/AdwaitaMono.woff2
  Adwaita Sans / Adwaita Mono (GNOME), subset to Latin by make-fonts.py.
  SIL Open Font License 1.1 – https://openfontlicense.org

fonts/pshell-icons.woff2
  The Material Design Icons glyphs of "Symbols Nerd Font" that
  style/theme/Icons.qml names, subset by make-fonts.py.
  Nerd Fonts: MIT License. Material Design Icons: Apache License 2.0
  (Pictogrammers).

qrcode.js
  QRCode for JavaScript, Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License,
  as ported to node by qrcode-terminal (Apache License 2.0), bundled into one
  ES module.

../js/world.js
  Land outlines from Natural Earth 1:110m (public domain), simplified.

pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs, pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs
  PDF.js (pdfjs-dist 4.10.38, legacy build), Mozilla Foundation and
  contributors, Apache License 2.0 – https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
